name: atspm_detector
status: first public release. Trained on the high-resolution logs of several hundred signals (phase from the official controller timing, function from configuration exports checked against cabinet prints); evaluated by six-fold signal-grouped cross-validation and once on 115 held-out signals
what_it_does: per detector from the hi-res controller log alone: phase, function (Advance / Presence / Count / Yellow_Red / Mid / Bike / Other), lanes, setback distance, night speed; detector health is a separate output computed after classification and never read by it
phase_anonymous: no phase number, channel number, channel order or channel difference is a model input; checked by the package check (phase renumbering, channel reversal / shift, random channel bijection + phase renumbering)

pipeline.phase: pair ranker (phase_lgbm_v5_s0, 261 features) -> network pair phase head (funcnet x100_w32full{,_s1,_s2}, kept pairs = ranker p >= .01) blended 0.5 / 0.5 -> joint decoder decode_v3 (25 features: first-stage probabilities, candidate claims, similarity + lead neighbours)
pipeline.function: function229_s0 trees (229 features) + network function head (same pass) -> stacker mean3 (46 columns) -> per-lane ATSPM decode (lane confidence >= .9); < 30 min: twin decode
pipeline.lanes: lane_pair_D_s0..s2 pair model + constrained decode (>= 30 min)
pipeline.setback: P50 per length group (m30 / h6 / h24 / full) + P10 / P90 band (3 + 3 seeds) + same-lane pair HGB
pipeline.health: rule checks on the log (health_core.py, health_v4.py, health_v4_stats.py) against per-type limits fitted once on healthy training detectors (weights/health/health_v4_refs.json); computed after classification, never a model input

accuracy_oof_six_fold.phase_source: six signal-grouped folds, out-of-fold, 3 seeds, 761 signals; E = exact phase
accuracy_oof_six_fold.function_source: six signal-grouped folds, out-of-fold, 3 seeds, 642 signals; ATSPM score (Advance / Presence / Count / Yellow_Red errors only, stacked same-role detectors credited)

accuracy_held_out.note: 115 signals never used for training or tuning, scored once for this model as a confirmation; 95 % signal-bootstrap intervals: phase .9704-.9891, function .8927-.9434 (>= 30 min)

runtime: CPU, onnxruntime (ORT_ENABLE_ALL, sequential, 4 intra-op threads, no spinning; network sessions without memory arena); DuckDB in-memory, 4 threads; numpy, pandas, duckdb, onnxruntime only
held_out_never_used: 115 held-out signals: no training or tuning; scored once for the final model (accuracy_held_out)
labels: phase = official controller timing; function = configuration exports with the agency's corrections and cabinet-print readings
one_path: the network runs at every sample length; predict(profile=), --profile and DC_FAST_PROFILE are accepted for compatibility and ignored with a FutureWarning
health_reference: health/health_v4_refs.json: per-type limit tables; night model and day band fitted on all training data
health_severity: bad = health score below .25 (e.g. one finding scored .75 or more), two independent findings, or a problem lasting 4 h or more of the day (busy at night 01-05 h, unusual daily pattern >= 4 h, silent >= 4 h, unexplained time ON in >= 16 15-min periods; 4-h rule adopted 2026-10-08); otherwise suspect
